theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_restricted_radon_converges
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Euclidean N)) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n)) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n)) (Ws : ℕ → Varifold N n Ω) (W : Varifold N n Ω) (c : ℝ≥0∞), VagueConverges μs μ → c ≠ ∞ → (∀ i, (Ws i).measure = c • (μs i).restrict (Ω ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)))) → W.measure = c • μ.restrict (Ω ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) → Varifold.RadonConverges Ws W
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
